title: 🤖 AI agents now have faces and voices
description:
Pika Labs launched the first video chat skill for AI agents. 
Your agent can now have a face, a voice, and join your meetings in real time. 
You can ask it to check your calendar, book an appointment, summarize action items, or remind you of details from a client proposal.
